data.title: Upcoming Workshop
descriptions: Join our next workshop to deepen your skills in data science and machine learning. This session will focus on enhancing ETL processes using SQL and PySpark, providing a hands-on learning experience through a business case study.
Date and Time: Friday, November 29, 2024, from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM MST
Location: Online (the Zoom link will be shared on Discord and social media prior to the workshop)

bullets.title: DSMLC Clouds and Businesses: Enhancing ETL with SQL and PySpark
bullets.text: This workshop provides a comprehensive understanding of the loading phase in the ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) data pipeline. Participants will learn SQL fundamentals, benefits, and best practices for writing SQL queries. Using Google Colab, we'll explore data querying and data distribution with PySpark through a real-world business case study.

data.title: Our Previous Workshops
